exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal/cesarean section due to fetopelvic disproportion)
cohort: 214 women aged 15-55 years, 171 with vaginal delivery and 43 with cesarean section due to fetopelvic disproportion
finding: The anterior pelvic index (API) is a good predictor of fetopelvic disproportion, with a cut-off point of 14.19.
mod_finding: An API value of more than 15.83 indicates a pelvis suitable for vaginal delivery.
